question: In Northeast India, the Ahoms celebrate this festival on January 31 every year in all traditional costumes and pomp at a common place to worship their ancestors. Identify the festival.
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Me Dum Me Fee**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Me Dum Me Fee** is an important festival celebrated by the **Ahom community** in Northeast India.
 
• The festival is observed to pay homage to the **ancestors** of the community.
 
• It is celebrated on **January 31** every year with traditional costumes, rituals, and pomp.
 
• During the festival, people gather at a common place to perform rituals and worship their ancestors as part of their traditional belief system.
 
• The name "**Me Dum Me Fee**" translates to "offering oblations to the dead" in the Ahom language, signifying the cultural importance of honoring ancestors.
 
• This festival reflects the **cultural heritage** and traditional practices of the Ahom community in Assam.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Doljatra**__

 __
 
• **Doljatra**, also known as **Dol Purnima**, is a Hindu festival celebrated primarily in Bengal and Odisha.
 
• It coincides with **Holi** and involves worship of **Lord Krishna**.
 
• Devotees place idols of Krishna and Radha on a palanquin and celebrate with colors and songs.
 
 
 
• **Jonbeel Fair**__
 __
 
• **Jonbeel Fair** is a unique fair held in Assam near **Jagiroad**.
 
• It is one of the few fairs in India where **barter system** is still practiced.
 
• People from tribal communities exchange goods without monetary transactions.
 
 
 
• **Rongkar**__
 
 
• **Rongkar** is another festival celebrated in Assam, mostly by tribal communities.
 
• It is primarily a **harvest festival**, marking the beginning of the agricultural season.
 
• The festival involves prayers for a good harvest and protection from natural calamities.
